highlights: Major AI players are pushing the boundaries of multimodal generation and agentic capabilities, with OpenAI launching faster image generation with GIFs and SVG, and Google introducing cost-effective video generation with Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash.

Significant advancements in agent intelligence and reliability are emerging, including new frameworks for operational control, resource orchestration, and provably safe multi-agent planning, alongside a new cybersecurity agent from OpenAI.

Efficiency in AI inference and development tooling is a key focus, with releases like Together Compiler for faster inference, OpenAI's Pando Git backend for scaling large monorepos, and Anthropic's FlashProve enhancing AI output trustworthiness.

agents.title: OpenAI Launches GPT‑6 Cyber: Aligned Cybersecurity Agents
agents.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Cyber, a new frontier model specifically trained to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes within authorized scopes, advancing AI's role in proactive cybersecurity defense.

agents.title: Agent Harness Awareness: Verified Telemetry for Operational Control in Tool-Using Agents
agents.summary: This research introduces Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design enabling tool-using agents to leverage verified host telemetry for improved operational control, significantly reducing policy regret and increasing task completion success.

agents.title: SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects in Real Code Repositories
agents.summary: SlackBench is a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on complex, real-world collaborative engineering and research workflows, testing their ability to reason over workplace communication and evolving code repositories.

models.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst: Adds GIFs, SVG Export and 6-Second API Generation
models.summary: OpenAI's Images 2.6 introduces GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst API models, offering image generation in as little as 6 seconds, GIF output, SVG export, and markup editing capabilities, significantly enhancing multimodal creation for developers.

models.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and Cost-Effective Video Generation with Longer Clips
models.summary: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash model brings native 15-second video generation and editing capabilities with stronger consistency and 30% lower pricing, making advanced video AI more accessible and efficient for builders.

models.title: Ricursive AI Releases Ripple-65B Preview: 65B Dense Open-Weight Model Scores 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1
models.summary: Ricursive Intelligence has released Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B dense open-weight LLM under Apache 2.0, demonstrating strong performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1, outperforming much larger open models.

tools.title: Together AI Releases Together Compiler: Agents Make Inference Up to 2.6x Faster
tools.summary: Together AI's Together Compiler, an agent-driven loop, continually re-optimizes the inference forward pass as traffic shifts, boosting inference performance by up to 2.6x TPS for AI models.

tools.title: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
tools.summary: OpenAI developed Pando, a Git-compatible backend for monorepos, which significantly cuts median push latency by nearly 80%, enabling more efficient development workflows for large-scale codebases.

tools.title: Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights
tools.summary: Anthropic's FlashProve is an Apache 2.0 zkSNARK prototype that cryptographically proves an LLM reply originated from committed model weights without revealing them, enhancing trust and verifiability in AI inference.

companies.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
companies.summary: OpenAI announced the acquisition of Pierre Computer Company, Inc., aimed at expanding Codex's tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code, signifying a strategic move to strengthen its developer offerings.

companies.title: OpenAI's Autonomous Pipeline Patches 948 Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities
companies.summary: OpenAI developed an autonomous pipeline that successfully identified, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel, demonstrating significant progress in AI-driven security automation.

companies.title: OpenAI Sets New Standard for Responsible AI Infrastructure with Community Compact and Policy Blueprint
companies.summary: OpenAI introduced its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint, outlining a commitment to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

learning.title: Iterated Creation, Grading, and Revision of Data Science Projects by Language Models
learning.summary: This research explores how agentic AI models can iteratively create, grade, and revise data science projects, demonstrating significant improvements with feedback loops and offering insights into AI-assisted automation of data science workflows.

learning.title: Can Large Language Models Review the Scientific Literature? A Test Against a 102-Article Benchmark
learning.summary: A comprehensive evaluation highlights LLMs' potential to assist with scientific literature discovery and interpretation, while emphasizing the continued necessity of expert human judgment for critical synthesis and evaluation.

learning.title: Google AI Quest: Mapping the Human Brain
learning.summary: Google has released a new AI Quest lesson titled 'Polar Peaks' focused on neuroscience, offering an interactive learning opportunity to enhance AI literacy through the exploration of mapping the human brain.
